desc:
📱 Run your own phone repair shop!

Customers walk in with cracked screens, dead batteries, water damage and even phones full of bugs (real bugs!). Haggle a price, sit down at your bench and fix them by hand: unscrew, heat, pry, solder and swap parts. Then hand them back and get paid!

🔧 Buy better tools at Gadget Galaxy
👥 Hire technicians and cashiers on Bloxedin. They keep earning while you're away!
🤖 Build RoboFix robots that fix devices on their own
⭐ Earn 5-star reviews and grow your shop
💰 Sell fixed-up phones in your glass case and set your own prices
🔁 Rebirth to unlock a 2nd floor, tablets, laptops, consoles and PCs
🕶️ Feeling sneaky? Ghost sells dummy phones... just watch out for the police!
🎁 Free daily rewards
👋 Your Roblox friends show up as customers!

🎁 Plus members receive a 0.25x money multiplier!

🌍 Plays in your language (18 languages)

Favorite the game so you don't miss updates!
